name: Who Do You Think You Are?
description: From roots in the Deep South to the slums of New Jersey, "Who Do You Think You Are?" follows the journeys of some of the most well-known names in American popular culture. Watch as celebrities discover unknown details about themselves and their families while researching their ancestry with the help of historians and genealogical experts.

videos.title: Sarah Jessica Parker
videos.overview: Sarah Jessica Parker is a celebrated icon in film and television as well as fashion, who recently served as a producer and reprised her Emmy Award-winning role as Carrie Bradshaw for the screen adaptation of the hit HBO series "Sex and the City." The actress took an emotional journey from coast to coast in search of her family's roots, crossing paths with the California Gold Rush and the Salem Witch Trials.

videos.title: Emmitt Smith
videos.overview: Emmitt Smith is an NFL Hall of Fame running back who, since retirement, has devoted himself to business and giving back to the community. But recently, he decided to embark on a journey inward, tracing his family's past. It was a journey that took him beyond his wildest expectations, discovering not only his African roots, but his connections to slave owners in Virginia.

videos.title: Lisa Kudrow
videos.overview: Lisa Kudrow journeys to the small Jewish town of Ilya where she discovers how her great-grandmother died in the Holocaust. Yet, Lisa finds hope when she uncovers a 60-year old family mystery.

videos.title: Matthew Broderick
videos.overview: On his journey to learn more about his paternal roots, Matthew Broderick discovers the heroic story of his grandfather during World War I and finds the final resting place of his great-great-grandfather who fought in the Civil War.

videos.title: Brooke Shields
videos.overview: Brooke learns a tragic secret about her grandmother and then discovers a connection to royalty through her paternal roots.

videos.title: Susan Sarandon
videos.overview: Susan leads an emotionally charged search for her family roots. Starting with her estranged grandmother Anita who abandoned Susan's mother in early childhood, Susan's journey takes her all the way to Tuscany, Italy. Back in America, Susan discovers a surprising connection to her grandmother.

videos.title: Spike Lee
videos.overview: Spike begins his journey in Atlanta, Georgia, where his grandmother Zimmie worked in the segregated Southern systems for many years. Here, Spike follows the trail of his ancestors dating back to the Civil War and discovers a shocking family connection.

videos.title: Vanessa Williams
videos.overview: Vanessa Williams sets out on a journey to find out if her ancestors were also trailblazers.

videos.title: Tim McGraw
videos.overview: The country music superstar uncovers his father's heritage among the Founding Fathers.

videos.title: Rosie O'Donnell
videos.overview: The search for her mother's roots takes Rosie to Ireland, and uncovers a new branch of the family.

videos.title: Kim Cattrall
videos.overview: Kim Cattrall travels to her native England to discover what happened to her grandfather, who abandoned his family to poverty when Kim's mother was only eight years old.

videos.title: Lionel Richie
videos.overview: Lionel Richie sets out to unlock the mystery of the man his beloved grandmother never spoke about - her father, John Louis Brown.

videos.title: Steve Buscemi
videos.overview: Steve Buscemi seeks a compelling story on his mother's side of the family, and finds it in his great-great-grandfather Ralph B. Montgomery.

videos.title: Gwyneth Paltrow
videos.overview: Gwyneth Paltrow's exploration of both sides of her family shows her the importance of teaching her kids that where they come from is important.

videos.title: Ashley Judd
videos.overview: Actress Ashley Judd discovers a connection to the first American settlers while investigating her ancestral past.

videos.title: Martin Sheen
videos.overview: Actor Martin Sheen traces his family tree, hoping to find his ancestors shared his love of activism; Martin discovers a family secret from the 1700s.

videos.title: Marisa Tomei
videos.overview: Actress Marisa Tomei travels to Italy to uncover the truth about her great-granddather's death.

videos.title: Blair Underwood
videos.overview: Actor Blair Underwood utilizes a DNA test to dig deeper into his family's roots, where he discovers the secret of his family's origin.

videos.title: Reba McEntire
videos.overview: Country music star Reba McEntire heads to Raleigh, North Carolina as she explores her mother's ancestry.

videos.title: Jerome Bettis
videos.overview: Former professional football player Jerome Bettis travels to Kentucky to learn about his mother's side of the family.

videos.title: Helen Hunt
videos.overview: As actress Helen Hunt looks into her paternal family history, she uncovers missing information about her ancestors.

videos.title: Rita Wilson
videos.overview: Actress Rita Wilson travels to Greece and Bulgaria to learn more about her late father.

videos.title: Edie Falco
videos.overview: Actress Edie Falco's journey to learn more about her mother's side of the family leads her to Milwaukee and England.

videos.title: Rob Lowe
videos.overview: Actor Rob Lowe examines his family history.

videos.title: Rashida Jones
videos.overview: Actress Rashida Jones learns about her family history on her mother's side.

videos.title: Jason Sudeikis
videos.overview: Actor Jason Sudeikis heads to Chicago to research the life and death of his paternal grandfather and makes a discovery about his great great grandfather in Pennsylvania.

videos.title: Paula Deen
videos.overview: Chef Paula Deen investigates her family history and learns about an event that affected her ancestors during the Civil War.

videos.title: Kelly Clarkson
videos.overview: Singer Kelly Clarkson explores her lineage and uncovers an ancestor deeply rooted in American history; she comes face-to-face with her 3x great grandfather's wartime bravery and sacrifice.

videos.title: Christina Applegate
videos.overview: Actress Christina Applegate investigates her paternal grandmother - a stranger to her and her father. Uncovering dramatic details along the way, Christina gains insight into the life and hardships of the woman she and her father loved, but never knew.

videos.title: Chelsea Handler
videos.overview: Media mogul Chelsea Handler confronts a deep family secret: her Grandfather’s rumored Nazi past. As she dives into her family’s struggle to survive in a desperate time, the details uncovered will finally confirm or deny his affiliation to the dark regime.

videos.title: Zooey Deschanel
videos.overview: Actress Zooey Deschanel searches for rumored abolitionists in her father’s Ouaker family background. Her journey takes her around Pennsylvania where she uncovers, and follows, the story of a remarkable ancestor who sacrificed everything for her beliefs.

videos.title: Chris O'Donnell
videos.overview: In memory of his late father, actor Chris O’Donnell investigates the paternal side of his family and finds ancestors on the frontlines of American history. Chris explores a patriotic legacy and a family devotion that extends deeper than he ever imagined.

videos.title: Cindy Crawford
videos.overview: World famous supermodel Cindy Crawford takes a journey to discover her family origins. With travels to the UK and beyond, she discovers ancestors dating back to the English Civil War, and even finds a connection linking her to early European royalty!

videos.title: Trisha Yearwood
videos.overview: Since her parents passed, country singer Trisha Yearwood knows little about her paternal side of the family. Her search for a deeper family connection takes Trisha to England, where she uncovers an ancestor’s history of crime, loss, and perseverance.

videos.title: Jim Parsons
videos.overview: In tribute to his late father, actor Jim Parsons explores the ancestors on his paternal side of the family. The journey takes Jim to Louisiana and eventually France, where he discovers generations of his forefathers who made an indelible mark in history.

videos.title: Valerie Bertinelli
videos.overview: Valerie Bertinelli goes on the hunt to unlock her family’s mysteries. She tracks down courageous ancestors who suffered through hardship and tragedy, and discovers a royal lineage dating back centuries that she never dreamed possible.

videos.title: Kelsey Grammer
videos.overview: Kelsey Grammer takes a trip into the past to explore his beloved grandmother’s family. He uncovers the story of a woman haunted by demons, and finds a connection to family who risked everything in one of the greatest migrations in American history.

videos.title: Minnie Driver
videos.overview: Minnie Driver unravels the deep family secrets her late father kept hidden. She discovers how the ravages of war nearly destroyed him, tracks down a long lost relative for the first time, and forms an unlikely bond with an ancestor she never knew existed.

videos.title: Julie Chen
videos.overview: Television personality Julie Chen uncovers a dramatic tale when she sets out for rural China to learn more about her maternal grandfather, who died long before she was born.

videos.title: Josh Groban
videos.overview: Singer Josh Groban traces his ancestry to Germany and discovers a relative who was a deacon, music teacher and well-known astronomer.

videos.title: Angie Harmon
videos.overview: Actress Angie Harmon discovers an ancestor who gave up his freedom to come to America and fought for independence at a pivotal point in history.

videos.title: Sean Hayes
videos.overview: Actor/Producer Sean Hayes searches for the cause of his estranged father's troubled past and uncovers a shocking trail of tragedy and crime that reaches back generations.

videos.title: Tony Goldwyn
videos.overview: Actor Tony Goldwyn researches his maternal ancestry and discovers a heritage of political activism along with a couple who proudly fought for abolition, women's rights and westward expansion.

videos.title: America Ferrera
videos.overview: America Ferrera learns about her great-grandfather's pivotal role in Honduran history, and seeks a connection to the father she hardly knew.

videos.title: Bill Paxton
videos.overview: Actor Bill Paxton searches his paternal ancestry and uncovers a war hero from a historic battle who shaped politics in the past.

videos.title: Melissa Etheridge
videos.overview: Music artist Melissa Etheridge researches her French roots, discovering a scandalous lawsuit and a relationship entangled with tragedy.

videos.title: Ginnifer Goodwin
videos.overview: In the Season 7 premiere, Ginnifer Goodwin hopes to connect her father with the grandparents he never knew, and uncovers a dark side of her family tree that includes instability and drug addiction.

videos.title: J.K. Rowling
videos.overview: JK Rowling sets off on a journey to uncover her maternal French roots. She stumbles upon a family mystery, and uncovers a harrowing tale of wartime heroism, then discovers the actions of a brave ancestor.

videos.title: Alfre Woodard
videos.overview: Alfre Woodard investigates the paternal side of her family and explores the origins of her surname.

videos.title: Bryan Cranston
videos.overview: Bryan Cranston's happy childhood shattered when his father abandoned the family when Bryan was just 11. Seeking answers, Bryan explores his paternal roots, finds a troubling pattern of desertion, a man of honor and an aunt he never even knew existed.

videos.title: Tom Bergeron
videos.overview: Television personality Tom Bergeron researches his paternal roots in France and discovers his nine-times great grandmother, Marguerite, who endured upheaval and faced going against her Protestant upbringing in order to survive.

videos.title: Aisha Tyler
videos.overview: Aisha Tyler's journey reveals an ancestor who, as a politician, struggled to keep his illegitimate son a secret. Against all odds, her 2x great-grandfather exemplifies bravery and determination during one of America's most tumultuous eras of racism.

videos.title: Scott Foley
videos.overview: Tracing his patriotic roots, Scott Foley finds a relative who risked his life for one of America’s founding fathers, and an ancestor who suffered unspeakably during one of this nation’s darkest times.

videos.title: Katey Sagal
videos.overview: Katey Sagal has an emotional and insightful meeting with her mother's friend and fellow USO performer. Katey also finds a surprising link to the Amish and uncovers the harrowing story of her relative's daring escape from attackers.

videos.title: Molly Ringwald
videos.overview: Molly Ringwald explores family lore of Swedish royalty, which uncovers her ancestors' harrowing lives and reveals women who suffered through unspeakable tragedies, and one brave immigrant who forever changed her family's fate.

videos.title: Chris Noth
videos.overview: Chris Noth discovers the suffering endured by his ancestors in America, and tracks a relative from Spain to Ireland who eventually became a war hero.

videos.title: Lea Michele
videos.overview: Lea Michele digs into her Jewish roots and finds a heartbreaking story about her great-grandmother in addition to a family reunited after being separated for decades.

videos.title: Courteney Cox
videos.overview: Courteney Cox traces her maternal line back to ambitious and ruthless relatives who plotted and murdered their way to power in medieval times; and she's shocked to discover an ancestor who's one of European history's most famous characters

videos.title: Julie Bowen
videos.overview: Julie Bowen makes a shocking discovery that a beloved relative lead a nefarious organization that triggered a dark chapter of U.S. history; and uncovers another ancestor who risked everything to fight for the lives and freedom of African Americans.

videos.title: Jennifer Grey
videos.overview: Jennifer Grey discovers much more about the grandfather she thought she knew as she uncovers how he survived adversity to become a beacon of his community; and discovers a great-grandmother whose devastating tragedy stopped her from making it to America.

videos.title: Noah Wyle
videos.overview: Noah Wyle investigates his maternal family line, discovering an ancestor who was catapulted into one of America's biggest wars, and whose life spiraled out of control from remarkable success to a shocking and tragic end.

videos.title: Jessica Biel
videos.overview: Jessica Biel hunts for the truth behind family lore surrounding the death of an ancestor. She also makes two shocking discoveries that shake everything she knows about her heritage to the core.

videos.title: Smokey Robinson
videos.overview: Motown legend and icon, Smokey Robinson tracks down a grandfather tangled in a swirl of controversy and connects to a relative's familiar struggle with oppression while coming face to face with the gruesome history he knew was inevitable.

videos.title: John Stamos
videos.overview: Actor John Stamos explores his Greek heritage for the first time and discovers an explosive feud that shattered his grandfather's childhood. He also meets a relative he never knew and hears firsthand about his family's enduring strength.

videos.title: Liv Tyler
videos.overview: Actress Liv Tyler unravels the mystery of her father Steven Tyler’s maternal family line, uncovering ancestors who took part in famous American battles. She also learns the shocking truths that will change the way she sees herself, and her family, forever.

videos.title: Jon Cryer
videos.overview: Jon Cryer's journey takes him from America to Scotland as he uncovers the dramatic tale of an ancestor who survived a catastrophic battle, endured horrific conditions as a prisoner of war, and was forced to come to America as an indentured servant.

videos.title: Laverne Cox
videos.overview: Actress and activist Laverne Cox pieces together the inspiring life of her African American ancestor, who challenged societal norms and bravely pushed the boundaries just years after Emancipation.

videos.title: Megan Mullally
videos.overview: Megan Mullally explores a shocking pattern of dysfunction in her father's line; she finds her two-times great grandmother was bravely defying societal norms in order to fight for her family's survival, while struggling to hang on to her own sanity.

videos.title: Hilary Duff
videos.overview: Actress Hilary Duff uncovers the tale of an ancestor who bravely led an American colony to battle a notorious gang of pirates; she dives centuries-deep into her Scottish roots and is shocked to discover that she descends from a heroic medieval king.

videos.title: Molly Shannon
videos.overview: Actress Molly Shannon heads to Ireland in search of her mother’s unknown family tree. She finds desperate ancestors forced to choose between their faith and survival; uncovers a family legacy of bravery; and meets Irish cousins for the first time.

videos.title: Jean Smart
videos.overview: Actress Jean Smart uncovers the curious tale of an unconventional ancestor in colonial Massachusetts, who got her children entangled in her own thievery ring and later faced execution when she was accused of witchcraft.

videos.title: Mandy Moore
videos.overview: Actress Mandy Moore is shocked to discover ancestors who lived in Australia and travels far, determined to unlock the mystery of how they got there. Moore is touched by the courage of those who made the journey and the sacrifice of those who were left behind.

videos.title: Josh Duhamel
videos.overview: Actor Josh Duhamel travels to England to investigate the extraordinary life of his twelve times great-grandfather and uncovers an astonishing, dark twist of interrogation and torture that rocks his belief system to the core.

videos.title: Regina King
videos.overview: Actress Regina King investigates her maternal family tree and uncovers an ancestor who was a passionate civil rights activist in Alabama; a man who came out of slavery, endured horrific violence, but never stopped fighting for his people.

videos.title: Matthew Morrison
videos.overview: Actor Matthew Morrison explores his American roots for the first time and is surprised to discover his family's ties to the Revolutionary War. He learns of the bold lengths his ancestor went through to protect his allegiances and the brutality he faced on the battlefield.

awards: Won 1 Primetime Emmy. 1 win & 6 nominations total
